items.title: Statistics snapshot for June 2027
items.body: Quarterly figures on author positions were refreshed. Six records are now public.

items.title: DEMO-2027-006 released: proof incomplete
items.body: Released 90 days after the authors were notified, without a substantive reply. The corollary is not claimed to be false.

items.title: DEMO-2027-004 released: the authors disagree
items.body: Released after an additional check by the researcher. The authors' position is summarised in the record.

items.title: DEMO-2027-001 version 1.2: external replication
items.body: An outside researcher reproduced the counterexample independently.

items.title: DEMO-2027-003 released after a published erratum
items.body: The erratum does not mention this audit; the record says so.

items.title: DEMO-2027-001 version 1.1: corrigendum published
items.body: The journal published a corrigendum that credits this audit.

items.title: Our correction to DEMO-2027-005
items.body: Version 1.0 overstated the search scope (five bidders instead of four). Version 1.1 corrects it.

items.title: DEMO-2027-005 released: a negative deep audit
items.body: No defect found within the stated scope.

items.title: First statistics snapshot (March 2027)
items.body: Programme-wide counts under metric definitions version 1.1.

items.title: First records released
items.body: DEMO-2027-001 (a confirmed defect in an application) and DEMO-2027-002 (a negative deep audit). Methodology version 1.0 published.
